newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia housing finance data good - industry.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia housing finance data good - industry.

text.p: An increase in Australian housing finance commitments in December pointed to an upturn in the housing market, building industry groups said on Tuesday.

"The increase in the December number of housing finance commitments is an early indicator that the cuts in official interest rates in November and December are starting to impact positively on the housing market," Master Builders Australia national director economics and housing, Wilhelm Harnisch, said in a statement.
Finance commitments for owner-occupied housing rose a seasonally-adjusted 5.3 percent to 40,500 dwellings in December.
"It is expected that further increases will be recorded in the coming months," Harnisch said.
"On this basis and given that housing finance is a leading indicator of new housing activity, it can be expected that the housing recovery will become more robust in the June quarter."
Real Estate Institute of Australia Ltd president Don Brindley also said the increase in housing finance boded well for sector.

"The ray of sunshine provided by the recent rate cuts, and the fact that increasing competition within the home loan market is making it easier to obtain housing finance, are encouraging the entry of buyers into the market," Brindley said in a statement.
